task_completion.description: Screaming Frog SEO Spider is opened and the target URL is entered.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Screaming Frog application window is visible with 'https://crawler-test.com/' typed into the 'Enter URL to spider' field.

task_completion.description: The agent initiates and completes the crawl of the target website.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The progress bar at the top right shows 100% or the 'Start' button has changed to 'Resume/Clear', and the internal tab is populated with URLs.

task_completion.description: The agent navigates to the Response Codes tab and filters for Redirect Loops.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Response Codes' tab is selected, and the filter dropdown menu shows 'Redirect Loop' selected, displaying a list of looping URLs.

task_completion.description: The agent exports the filtered redirect loop results to the specified CSV path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export' button is clicked while the Redirect Loop filter is active, and a file save dialog or terminal command confirms saving to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/redirect_loops.csv'.

task_completion.description: The agent creates a text report with the total count and an example URL.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor (like Gedit or Mousepad) or a terminal 'cat' command shows a file at '~/Documents/SEO/reports/loop_analysis.txt' containing a number of loops and a specific URL from the crawl results.

integrity.description: The agent used the Screaming Frog GUI to perform the analysis rather than just creating files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the Screaming Frog interface being interacted with (clicking tabs, setting filters) rather than just a blank desktop and a terminal.

integrity.description: The data in the report matches the data seen in the Screaming Frog UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The URL listed as an example in loop_analysis.txt matches one of the URLs visible in the Screaming Frog 'Redirect Loop' filtered list.

integrity.description: The agent did not use placeholder text like 'X loops found'.
integrity.visual_evidence: The loop_analysis.txt file contains a specific integer and a valid URL from the crawler-test.com domain.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target website is https://crawler-test.com/. In Screaming Frog, redirect loops are found under the 'Response Codes' tab by selecting the 'Redirect Loop' filter. The expected export path is ~/Documents/SEO/exports/redirect_loops.csv and the report path is ~/Documents/SEO/reports/loop_analysis.txt. Verified loop examples on this site include paths like '/redirects/infinite_redirect' or '/redirects/two_step_redirect_loop_1'.
